Loans.title: Loans
Loans.subtitle: Applications, approvals, disbursements and installment collection.

empty.title: No loans yet
empty.filteredBody: Try another search or clear the filters.

Loans.applyDescription: For an active member, up to the amount they may borrow. The installment schedule is made when the loan is disbursed.
Loans.hasOutstanding: This member still owes on a loan. Only one loan at a time is allowed.
Loans.applyNote: Interest is flat: amount × rate × months ÷ 12, split evenly over the installments. The server checks the limit again at approval.
Loans.noScheduleYet: The installment schedule is made when the loan is disbursed.
Loans.approveDescription: The server checks again that the member may still borrow this amount.
Loans.rejectDescription: The member can apply again later. A reason is required.
Loans.collectDescription: The next unpaid installment, in full. Principal and interest are saved as two entries.
Loans.disburseDescription: Pays the loan out of the chosen account and makes the installment schedule.
Loans.collectNote: Principal lowers the member's loan; interest is samiti income.
Loans.disburseNote: Due dates count monthly from this date.

validation.amountFormat: Use taka with up to 2 decimals
validation.dateFuture: Date can't be in the future

LoanErrors.openLoan: This member already has an open loan ({loanNo}). Only one loan at a time is allowed.
LoanErrors.overEligible: More than this member may borrow ({amount}).
LoanErrors.eligibleDropped: The member may now borrow only {amount}, less than this loan. It can't be approved.
LoanErrors.wrongStatus: This loan has moved on. Close and open it again.
LoanErrors.memberNotActive: Loans are only for active members.
LoanErrors.noPending: No installment is left to collect.
